title: QUIC RFC 9000 Stream-Control Frame Focused Proof Work Item
summary: Decompose RFC 9000 S19P4/S19P5 RESET_STREAM and STOP_SENDING frame proof into focused requirement-home tests and canonical trace evidence.
planned_changes:
- Add stream-control test support for protected RESET_STREAM/STOP_SENDING extraction and exact malformed payload construction.
- Add focused positive, negative, and edge requirement-home tests for RESET_STREAM and STOP_SENDING runtime emission, stream-state errors, field parsing, field formatting, truncation rejection, and maximum varint boundaries.
- Update canonical S19P4/S19P5 xrefs and regenerate coverage triage.
verification_plan: Run the focused S19P4/S19P5 requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, run a Release build, and validate SpecTrace JSON.
out_of_scope: Completing other RFC 9000 S19 frame families.
Changing packet-level connection-close emission policy for every malformed stream-control frame.
Changing public QUIC API behavior beyond the tested abort paths.
Claiming broader S3/S4 stream-state closure outside the linked behavior.
completion_notes: Completed as focused proof decomposition over existing RESET_STREAM and STOP_SENDING parser, formatter, stream-state, and runtime application-action behavior.
